claim: US Sen Kamala Harris failed the bar exam  (qualifying examination for lawyers)on her first attempt
justification: The high-confidence evidence from Fact-check A, corroborated by official State Bar records and multiple independent sources, consistently indicates that Kamala Harris passed the California Bar Exam on her first attempt in 1989. The low-confidence evidence from Fact-check B suggesting failure is contradicted and unreliable, so it is discounted. Therefore, the claim that she failed on her first attempt is refuted by trustworthy evidence.
